description: Parse the test log file at /home/ga/workspace/test_output.log (8000+ lines) to identify all failed tests and create a summary report. Failed tests follow the pattern 'FAILED test_file.py::test_name - ErrorType: error message'. Your task: (1) Use VSCode search (Ctrl+F or Find in Files) to find all lines starting with 'FAILED', (2) Extract the test names (format: test_file.py::test_name) and error types (AssertionError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, DatabaseError, APIError, IntegrityError), (3) Create a summary file at /home/ga/workspace/test_failures_summary.txt that lists all failed tests organized by error category, (4) Ensure the summary is concise (under 100 lines) and does not include false positives (lines containing 'ERROR' that aren't actual test failures). The summary should be human-readable and clearly show which tests failed and why.
